summary.text: 在 Finish、归档生成和 PR 边界统一增加 Implementation Knowledge freshness 校验，并在共享 source-bound 证据刷新后用 canonical generator 重建既有投影；不改写历史归档证据。

mechanism.text: Finish 在 source-bound 文档刷新后重建全部既有 projection 并登记变更；归档完成生成后再次调用 check_record/check_index；PR 聚合检查在仓库已有 knowledge surface 时验证整个 index，空 adopter 工程没有 index 或 records 时跳过该可选 surface。

affectedComponents.detail: Generated knowledge output cannot report success while its record or index is stale.
Rebase or merge drift in evidence-bound knowledge projections is rejected before merge.

designDecisions.decision: Use the existing canonical knowledge checker instead of duplicating digest logic.
designDecisions.reason: One freshness definition must govern archive, PR, and closure paths.

designDecisions.decision: Skip the PR knowledge check only when the repository has no knowledge surface at all.
designDecisions.reason: Fresh adopter projects must not be blocked before they create their first projection.

technicalDetails.detail: Any stale digest, missing record, missing index, or index drift returns a blocking validation issue; no green completion claim is emitted.

evidence.claim: All currently stale knowledge records were regenerated by the canonical generator and the repository knowledge checker passes.
